notes.title: New Steam Patch Live!
notes.notes: We have released a small new Steam patch last week that hopefully fixes any DRM issues anyone has been having--this seemed especially to be a problem with Windows 7 users, but now is fixed. Players will now be able to install the game on multiple rigs through Steam without 'breaking' their game as would happen before. We apologize that this took some time to fix, but we had to figure out what the problem was and work with Steam who generously gave us a lot of their time to create a new version. We also released a smaller and separate version of the IG: Warlord demo, so players will no longer encounter the issue where there is a demo and a full version installed but if you uninstall one, the other uninstalls as well. As usual, if you encounter any problems, please head on over to the Steam forums or email support@isotx.com for a quick resolution. One more thing, a new and very big patch is coming up still. I personally wrote some achievements today, and let me tell you, they're going to be devilish. Our new map has been tested quite a bit at the studios recently, so it's just a matter of getting these Steamwork features in before releasing it. We should have a release date soon. Thanks for reading and thanks for all the support, Monique aka Ashelia at ISOTX
